title: ToolLayer Deployment Snapshot
description: The immutable set of exact connector versions one runtime deployment may serve. A snapshot is never edited; a change produces a new snapshot with a new revision and a new digest.

snapshot_id.description: Opaque snapshot identity derived from the snapshot content digest.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing per deployment. Revisions are never reused.

snapshot_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of this document with snapshot_id and snapshot_digest removed. A consumer recomputes it before trusting the payload.

connectors.description: Exactly one published version per connector_key. Uniqueness is enforced semantically.
